other_conditions: The deceased construction worker must be registered with the Haryana Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (HBOCWWB).
The deceased construction worker must have held an active regular membership with the board.
Only the legal heir or dependent family member of the deceased registered worker is eligible to apply.
benefits_summary: A financial assistance of ₹2,00,000 is provided to the nominee/legal heir/dependent family members of the deceased registered worker.
